description: Source code for a CodeMirror mode implementation for Smalltalk language syntax highlighting.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents the current parsing context, including tokenizer and parent context.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a token with name, context, and end-of-stream flag.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Maintains parser state, including indentation and variable expectations.

methods.name: startState
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new parser state.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Processes the next token from the stream based on current state.

methods.name: blankLine
methods.description: Handles blank line events to reset indentation.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Calculates indentation level based on parser state and upcoming text.
